mapper.select: select * from integration_schema.cost_center t where t.controlling_area||'|'||t.cost_center_code in #{key}
mapper.insert:
insert into integration_schema.cost_center (controlling_area,cost_center_code,company_code,name,valid_from,valid_to,blocked,deleted,source_version,source_changed_at,payload_hash) values
(#{row.controllingArea},#{row.costCenterCode},#{row.companyCode},#{row.name},#{row.validFrom},#{row.validTo},#{row.blocked},#{row.deleted},#{row.sourceVersion},#{row.sourceChangedAt},#{row.payloadHash})
on conflict (controlling_area,cost_center_code) do update set company_code=excluded.company_code,name=excluded.name,valid_from=excluded.valid_from,valid_to=excluded.valid_to,blocked=excluded.blocked,deleted=excluded.deleted,source_version=excluded.source_version,source_changed_at=excluded.source_changed_at,payload_hash=excluded.payload_hash, synced_at=clock_timestamp() where integration_schema.cost_center.source_version <=< excluded.source_version
mapper.select: select count(*) from integration_schema.cost_center where (name ilike #{search} or cost_center_code ilike #{search})
select * from integration_schema.cost_center where (name ilike #{search} or cost_center_code ilike #{search}) order by id limit #{size} offset #{offset}
